tools.name: start_website_migration
tools.description: Prepare an existing public website for migration into Panderr. Returns a Panderr link where the user can begin the migration and open the resulting website project for editing.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_website_migration" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Prepare an existing public website for migration into Panderr. Returns a Panderr link where the user can begin the migration process. Project creation and editing happen later in Panderr." → after: "Prepare an existing public website for migration into Panderr. Returns a Panderr link where the user can begin the migration and open the resulting website project for editing."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.

findings.title: Tool removed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "start_zip_import" is no longer advertised. Removal can precede a shadowing replacement from another server.
